comment: Tier overrides applied on top of research/popularity.json (which stays untouched). Each rule sets `tier` for every scenario whose main utility is `function`, optionally only for the listed scenario `kinds` and `sizes`. The aggregation prints every rule and the scenarios it changed.

overrides.reason: Biggest adopter: @prisma/dev (29M downloads/month, 62% of remeda's own) calls only difference and range, both data-first (difference(range(a, b), used)); difference's mid popularity would otherwise drop these to tier 2.
The other half of the same @prisma/dev call (range data-first); range's mid popularity would otherwise drop it to tier 2.
